title: Gel membrane images used for testing IOCBIO Gel
format: ZIP archive; internal image format and bit depth unknown without inspecting archive
annotations: Article identifies paired membrane images for Ponceau, GAPDH and LTCC; filenames encode gel number and signal. Independent per-band ROI or intensity ground truth unknown.
license: Publisher states CC0 applies to article data unless an individual credit line says otherwise; article text/images CC BY 4.0. Archive-specific notices not inspected. Software GPLv3 is a separate license.
access_status: Publisher record and supplement download link accessed 2026-10-31; endpoint returned application/octet-stream unsupported by web reader; archive not downloaded or inspected.
size_if_verified: unknown archive size and internal file count; article comparison refers to three membranes, not a verified archive inventory
usable_for: Candidate paired-membrane import and lane identity tests after archive inspection
Candidate ROI/background and target/total-protein workflow development
Comparison protocol design for method differences
not_sufficient_for: Immediate commercial redistribution before archive-specific notices are checked
split_unit: Physical membrane/gel and biological experiment; keep all proteins, stain images, crops, exposures and derived rotations of the same membrane in one partition; only three reported membranes cannot establish broad independent generalization.
evidence_note: 2026-10-31 read publisher article dated 2023-10-20, Supplementary Information and Rights sections. Do not replace source membrane data with Figure 3 graphics. No image files downloaded. PMC mirror browser check failed; publisher text was readable.

title: Western blot raw data — Devin Clegg
format: ZIP; actual archive preview lists TIFF including some .raw16.tif filenames and at least one JPEG; pixel dtype, acquisition bit depth and uncropped status unknown
annotations: Archive folders include figure identifiers and numbered repeats, protein names, colorimetric/chemiluminescence variants and total-protein/Ponceau files; formal lane/sample map, ROI and angle ground truth unknown.
license: CC BY 4.0 explicitly declared in official record HTML rights metadata and license-link, checked 2026-10-31. Archive-specific notices not inspected.
access_status: Record and ZIP directory preview read; official HTML license metadata independently checked via ordinary HTTPS. ZIP not downloaded/decoded; still requires pixel/provenance inspection.
size_if_verified: 491.9 MB archive; record checksum md5:4452ad040602610f7788615681574556; total internal image count unknown
usable_for: Candidate multi-protein and multi-exposure WB development fixtures under CC BY 4.0 after archive inspection
not_sufficient_for: Using JPEG/colorimetric derivatives as chemiluminescence raw data
Archive redistribution without retaining attribution and inspecting any item-specific notices
split_unit: Biological experiment and physical membrane; keep same membrane's protein channels, exposures, crops, colorimetric views and total-protein images together. Do not split by archive filename or figure folder alone until lineage is verified.
evidence_note: Version v2 publication 2026-08-25; technical created/modified date 2026-08-26. Earlier v1 is zenodo.21110406 (461.3 MB), not a second independent dataset. Preview URL https://zenodo.org/records/22092552/preview/Westerns%20Raw%20Data.zip?include_deleted=0 was actually read. The suffix raw16 is a filename clue, not a dtype inspection. Text-only web extraction omitted license value; ordinary HTTPS HTML rights and JSON-LD explicitly state CC BY 4.0, evidenced by license-html-probe.json.

title: Human MCF7 and A549 cells cytoplasm–nucleus translocation
format: 8-bit BMP; 1360x1024 pixels; paired DAPI/FITC images; plate map XLS and TXT
annotations: 96-well plate map: 12 concentration points and four replicate rows for each cell type. Biological condition labels, not independent pixel masks or calibrated fluorescence truth.
license: CC BY 3.0 Unported, attributed to Ilya Ravkin
access_status: Record, license deed and actual ZIP endpoint accessed 2026-10-31; endpoint recognized application/zip, not downloaded or decoded.
size_if_verified: Image ZIP 121 MB; 96 wells, one field and two channel images per well per description; 192 images is a description-derived expectation, not archive inventory; plate map XLS 22 kB
not_sufficient_for: Absolute fluorescence calibration or accuracy tolerance
Proof that a treatment trend guarantees correct segmentation or normalization
split_unit: Well is the minimum grouping; keep paired channels and all derived crops together. Partition wells/condition groups deliberately; single-plate data cannot establish cross-batch or cross-laboratory holdout performance.
evidence_note: Version 1; record publication date unknown. Read 2026-10-31. BMP needs an explicitly tested lossless import adapter; do not pretend it is already within TIFF-only release scope. Plate map https://data.broadinstitute.org/bbbc/BBBC014/BBBC014_v1_platemap.xls is exposed by actual record link.

title: Human U2OS cells (out of focus)
format: 16-bit LZW-compressed TIF, 696x520; w1 Hoechst and w2 phalloidin; z plane archives; CSV counts and PNG labels
annotations: Expert in/out-of-focus classification; nuclear labels and counts generated by CellProfiler/Otsu rather than independent manual instance annotations.
license: Record states Anne Carpenter waived all copyright and related/neighbouring rights to images and ground truth to extent possible under law; no separate deed URL exposed in reviewed text
access_status: Record and z16 ZIP endpoint accessed 2026-10-31; endpoint recognized application/zip; no download or image inspection.
size_if_verified: z16 image ZIP 800 MB; record describes 384 wells x 2 sites = 768 fields. Total planes/files unresolved: prose says 32 image sets while download list shows z00-z33; do not multiply into an asserted total.
usable_for: Focus QC and exclusion branch development
Testing focus-dependent failures in IF and counting
Reproduction of an algorithm-generated reference baseline with explicit provenance
not_sufficient_for: Automatic z projection as a supported 2D method
split_unit: Well/site acquisition stack; keep all z planes, both channels and derivatives of the same field together, preferably group by well. Never split adjacent z planes between tuning and holdout.
evidence_note: Version 1; publication date unknown. Read 2026-10-31. z16 selected only because record declares optimal focus; z11-z23 are expert-classified in-focus. First download should be one approved subset, not all roughly 800 MB archives.

title: Nuclei of U2OS cells in a chemical screen
format: 16-bit TIFF, 520x696; color-encoded PNG instance masks; metadata ZIP with train/validation/test lists
annotations: Approximately 23000 manually annotated nuclear instances across 200 fields; touching instances use different colors requiring correct mask decoding.
access_status: Official record and download endpoints checked. Metadata ZIP (17,816 bytes) and masks ZIP (2,753,811 bytes) downloaded and archive directories inspected; image ZIP not downloaded. SHA-256 recorded in sample-download-verification.json.
size_if_verified: 200 fields, one DNA-channel field per compound; images.zip 77.9 MB, masks.zip 2.8 MB, metadata.zip 18 KB
not_sufficient_for: Untouched holdout if pretrained model or earlier tuning already used these images
split_unit: Respect provided train/validation/test lists; keep each field and all crops/augmentations together. Audit overlap with BBBC038 and source BBBC022, and pretrained-model exposure before calling test independent.
evidence_note: Version 1; cited dataset work 2018; page publication date unknown. Read 2026-10-31. Actual metadata endpoint https://data.broadinstitute.org/bbbc/BBBC039/metadata.zip. Masks download link is present on landing page; archive decoding not yet tested.

title: An annotated fluorescence image dataset for training nuclear segmentation methods
format: Raw .tif and ground-truth .tif/.svg plus .png/.jpg visualizations; raw-image dtype and bit depth unknown without decoding One verified file is 8-bit grayscale; do not generalize its encoding to entire dataset.
annotations: 79 expert-annotated fluorescence images, 7813 nuclei, heterogeneous tissue/cell-line and preparation origins; raw images, per-instance and visualization files are distinct.
access_status: Official record checked; one raw TIFF Neuroblastoma_0.tif downloaded (1,311,278 bytes) and fully decoded by Pillow: 1280×1024, L (8-bit grayscale), one frame, range 3..227. Corresponding label not downloaded; full study not downloaded.
size_if_verified: Record study size 472.2 MiB, 468 files, 388 image-type entries; these include derived labels/visualizations, not 388 independent raw specimens. Selected TIFF listed 1.3 MiB.
usable_for: Heterogeneous nuclear segmentation and count stress cases
Potential external nuclear holdout after lineage and model-exposure audit
not_sufficient_for: Treating derivative visualizations as raw intensity data
Independent patient holdout based only on random image names
split_unit: Patient/specimen, cell line/preparation and acquisition group where metadata allow; all fields, raw/label pairs and derivatives from a specimen remain together. Missing patient identity prevents claiming patient-independent holdout.
evidence_note: Archive release 2023-03-07. Record describes 79 original images despite 388 image entries. Related original BioStudies S-BSST265 dynamic page returned only Loading; do not count it as a separately validated dataset. Download URL is a real clicked record link, not constructed.

title: Murine bone-marrow derived macrophages
format: 25 image sets: DAPI, CD11b/APC and merged view; individual outline filenames end .tif; raw format/bit depth not verified
annotations: Per-cell and per-nucleus outlines; border-crossing and strongly overlapping/blurred objects intentionally excluded. Official page warns nuclear-outline archive is incomplete.
license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported; non-commercial restriction makes this a reference-only lead pending separate authorization for this commercial project
access_status: Official record, linked license deed and actual ZIP endpoint accessed 2026-10-31; endpoint recognized application/zip; no archive downloaded and not approved for project training/development/redistribution.
size_if_verified: 25 image sets; listed images ZIP 92 MB, nuclei outlines 2.0 MB, cell outlines 1.7 MB
usable_for: Public metadata review of whole-cell benchmark requirements and missing-label failure cases
not_sufficient_for: Authorized commercial-project data use without additional permission
Complete count truth for all visible objects
Treating unannotated border/blur objects as false positives
split_unit: Biological preparation/mouse and acquisition field, preserving all channels and object outlines; grouping identity unknown until metadata inspection. No split/use planned before rights clearance.
evidence_note: Version 1, source experiment cited 2012, page publication date unknown. Read 2026-10-31. Listed to make a genuine full-cell data gap visible; it does not fill the commercial whole-cell admission gate.
